description: Adds staff entries for four branches no real profile reaches. The first has neither role nor company, so PersonDialog falls back to 'Community member' (src/components/CommunityPeople/index.js line 63). The remaining three carry the three website shapes websiteUrl (src/lib/profile-links.mjs) resolves differently and data/community-people.json never contains: an absent blog (the typeof guard at line 51), a bare host with no scheme (the ternary's no-scheme arm at line 55, resolved against https rather than concatenated), and a value that parses as a scheme but not as a URL (the catch at line 62). The blog field is copied verbatim from a third-party GitHub profile, so every one of those shapes is an input the next refresh can deliver. Appended to 'staff' rather than 'tab' so the TAB roster assertions in tests/e2e/community-people.spec.js keep describing the real data; all three carry a role and a company so they cannot displace the role-less entry above.
